nodes.text: Patrol feed decrypted. Two cutters are aligning for docking arms and a reclaimer tug is holding back to torch the vault after the sweep. You have one clean exit vector if you move before they finish triangulating Veil's relay.

options.text: Mark the clean vector and keep the feed running.
Which section do they hit first?

nodes.text: Boarders sweep the vault side first. The medbay dies second. If you were planning to strip contraband and run, this is the warning that makes it possible.

options.text: Good. Keep them blind a little longer.
